_doc: Bosch Rexroth's T-bolt M6x20 for its 8 mm slot, M6 (3 842 523 921). Sold as M6x16, M6x20 and M6x25; this set is the M6x20. Fmax is Rexroth's.
name: slot-nut-8-bosch-m6-t-bolt

slot.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-6

thread.rule: Thread M6, one of the sizes the table lists (M6)
thread.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-6

nut_kind.rule: A bolt with a T head, dropped in and turned; a notch on its end shows which way the head lies
nut_kind.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-6

length.rule: The head along the slot: not dimensioned; taken as Rexroth's 8 mm T-nut (8)
length.source: scaled off Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-6 (not dimensioned)

width.rule: The head across the slot: not dimensioned; taken as Rexroth's 8 mm T-nut (16.5), which turns until it jams
width.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-6: not dimensioned there, so an estimate

height.rule: The head under the lips: not dimensioned; taken as Rexroth's 8 mm T-nut (6)
height.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-6: not dimensioned there, so an estimate

tongue_height.rule: The step into the opening: taken as Rexroth's 8 mm T-nut (1.5)
tongue_height.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-6: not dimensioned there, so an estimate

nut_entry.rule: Put in through the opening anywhere along the slot
nut_entry.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-6

bolt_length.rule: M6x20: L = 20, of which b = 14 is threaded (the table)
bolt_length.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-6

material.rule: Material as the table names it
material.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-6

hold.rule: Fmax 4000 N, as the catalogue rates it for the 8 mm slot (M6): the pull straight out of the slot
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-6
